podcast.title: Departure from The Pointer Sisters (1977)
podcast.body: Bonnie Pointer decided to leave the group for a solo career in 1977, following a period where the group's singles were underperforming on the charts. "With the group floundering, Bonnie Pointer decided it was time for a solo career."

podcast.title: Co-writer of "Fairy Tale"
podcast.body: Bonnie Pointer co-wrote the country song "Fairy Tale" with her sister Anita, inspired by Anita's personal experience of heartbreak. "With her sister Bonnie, she wrote a song that is 100% in the country vein."
